reference_sql:
SELECT channel,
       CASE WHEN net_revenue_eur IS NULL OR units IS NULL OR unit_cost_eur IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur < 0 THEN 'loss'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur < 0.2 * net_revenue_eur THEN 'thin'
            ELSE 'healthy'
       END AS margin_band,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM sales
GROUP BY channel, margin_band
